comment: Independent protected Rider ingestion variation: wear the ordinary ring of protection from shape changers before wishing Death corpse. This source property makes makemon skip temporary doppelganger initial newcham, The substituted monster has cham=NON_PM, so zap.c:revive does not explicitly restore Death and C reports the bite-covered doppelganger. The eat.c:cprefx shared Rider arm reaches done(DIED), wizard life-saving, Wisdom exercise, consumed revival return, and whole victual reset. The unprotected Death/Pestilence/Famine probes retain the startup VFS-record blocker.
